boundary_expansion.applies_to: each retained feature set and each Stage A linear family independently
boundary_expansion.rule: register exactly one outward decade when the family-specific inner one-standard-error winner uses regularization index 0 or 9; otherwise record no expansion

development_owned_decomposition.ar_uplift: inner raw PR-AUC minus matching inner event prevalence
development_owned_decomposition.fold_consistency: number of registered inner folds with strictly positive AR-versus-chance uplift
development_owned_decomposition.history_consumption: derive exact relative causal offsets from feature form and registered history depth, including padding availability
development_owned_decomposition.target_and_gap: read future target offsets and the empty no-washout gap from the sealed Phase 01 candidate registry
development_owned_decomposition.video_consistency: compute defined-only per-video simple-baseline metrics now; AR per-video consistency remains pending until immutable finalist predictions exist and may not be fabricated by refitting a converged Stage A cell

history_regions.derivation: three consecutive equal-size regions from the ordered 21-row VEATIC history grid

inner_aggregation.brier_order: finite mean Brier ascending, then undefined Brier; ridge Brier remains undefined
inner_aggregation.capacity_order: smaller history depth, then smaller feature count, then linear family rank, then stronger regularization, then stable identity
inner_aggregation.mean: unweighted arithmetic mean over the complete registered inner folds
inner_aggregation.one_standard_error_threshold: best mean inner raw PR-AUC minus the standard error of that best configuration
inner_aggregation.standard_error: sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(inner-fold count); zero for the single blocked inner fold

stage_b.ranking: feature-set representative selected from its 20 Stage A linear configurations by the registered one-standard-error rule; global one-standard-error members rank first by the registered tie resolution, followed by remaining representatives by descending mean inner raw PR-AUC and the same deterministic ties
stage_b.retention: take the best-ranked representative for each of six feature forms and each of low/mid/high history regions, union those obligations, then fill in global rank order to exactly 12; fail closed if any obligation or 12-candidate support is unavailable

stage_b_family_expansion.gru_applicability: raw_sequence_with_availability_mask only; every other feature form receives an explicit not-applicable architecture disposition

nonlinear_base.batch: largest power of two not exceeding sqrt(inner training rows)
nonlinear_base.width: next power of two of sqrt(input feature count)

stage_b_family_expansion.one_factor_at_a_time: include the base once, then vary exactly one applicable registered width, depth/layer, activation, dropout, optimizer, learning-rate, or batch factor while holding all others at base; deduplicate exact configurations
stage_b_family_expansion.stage_b_update_budget: the data-derived base budget for every elastic-net and OFAT nonlinear screen, with one frozen double to 2B only for an unplateaued/undertrained curve; later escalation follows the frozen Stage C/D rules
